note: RFC 4271 Section 9.1.2 requires installing the selected route in Loc-RIB, replacing any route to the same destination currently held there. TestRFC4271SelectedRouteReplacesTheLocRIBRoute drives handleReceivedStructured with peer A then better peer B and asserts Loc-RIB best moves to peer B; TestRFC4271LocRIBHoldsOnlyTheReplacingRoute inspects Loc-RIB paths and asserts strictly one BGP path survives; TestLocRIBMirror confirms checkBestPathChange mirroring into Loc-RIB.
